description: Admit one raw session chunk for the specified IngestSourceKind. Returns a durable {job_id, status: queued} admission. The existing session_ledger_service owner drains pushes, selected polls and repairs in FIFO order with one writer. Retrieve that exact job through service_interface::job_service::get_job: job.result contains the complete {events_persisted, batch_id} report; job.error exposes a typed failure. A queued admission is acceptance of the request, not successful ingestion. Inspect failed or uncertain jobs before retry: ledger effects may already have committed and requests are never automatically replayed. Direct internal Python calls remain synchronous.
embedding_description: Queue a pushed session chunk on the serial ledger owner and return its persisted job id promptly. Poll job_service.get_job by that exact id for the final event count, push batch id or typed error. Concurrent pushes preserve admission order and never overlap session upserts. Optional source_id binds the exact source row. Uses the unchanged source-kind parser and importer.dispatch_pushed body. Distinct from trigger_poll (pulling-source heartbeat).
